tasks.title: Batch viral scorer — scripts/scs001/batch-viral-score.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/batch-viral-score.ts. Scans workspace/scs001/run-*/caption/*-captioned.mp4. For each: spawns viral-scorer.py, reads result, updates experiments.jsonl entry with viral scores. Skips already-scored entries. Prints progress + summary. --dry-run flag. Uses ViralScorer from viral-scorer.ts.
tasks.context: Sprint 188. 141 existing videos have no viral scores. This batch runner backfills them so /review can prioritize by viral score.

tasks.title: Hook quality text scorer — scripts/scs001/hook-quality.ts
tasks.description: Create scripts/scs001/hook-quality.ts. Export hookQualityScore(hookText: string, whyDoesThisMatter: string): number (0-1). Scores based on: (1) hook length 5-15 words = optimal, (2) contains question/number/superlative = +0.1 each, (3) matches viral trigger words (awe/shock/surprise/nostalgia/amusement keywords) = +0.15 each, (4) why_does_this_matter specificity (number + proper noun) = +0.1 each. Capped at 1.0. Pure TypeScript, no deps.
tasks.context: Sprint 188. Lightweight text-only viral signal. No Python deps. Works even when scenedetect/librosa not installed.

tasks.title: Wire hook quality into ClipDetectionAgent scoring
tasks.description: In agents/scs001-clip-detection/index.ts, import hookQualityScore. In the scoring callback, call hookQualityScore(ts.reason || topicText, disc.speaker). Add hook_quality_score to ClipQualityScore interface. Add triggerBonus weight: total = baseLlmScore + triggerBonus + Math.round(hookQuality * 3). Surgical edit only.
tasks.context: Sprint 188. Hook quality score boosts clip quality score by 0-3 points (on 25-point scale). Lightweight text analysis.
